title: debt-ratchet-base
responsibility: Owns the debt-ratchet-base build or maintenance script.

inputs.name: selectRatchetBase.git
inputs.description: Runs one read-only git command from an argument list and returns its output as a string; it throws when git fails. selectRatchetBase calls it only with rev-parse and merge-base arguments and treats a throw or blank output as no result.

inputs.name: selectRatchetBase.env
inputs.description: The environment map that selectRatchetBase reads: only HARNESS_DEBT_RATCHET_BASE and GITHUB_BASE_REF are used, each trimmed first, and an undefined value counts as unset. A non-empty HARNESS_DEBT_RATCHET_BASE that is not all zeros is tried first and, when it resolves to a commit, wins; GITHUB_BASE_REF names the origin branch that is tried before origin/main and main.

outputs.name: ratchetBaseVariable
outputs.description: The exported constant is the environment variable name HARNESS_DEBT_RATCHET_BASE, which selectRatchetBase reads for a ref or commit that replaces the protected-branch lookup. It is a fixed string, and the messages from selectRatchetBase quote this same name.

outputs.name: selectRatchetBase
outputs.description: The RatchetBase chosen for this checkout: commit is the full commit hash to compare against, or null when HEAD does not resolve or HEAD has no parent and no candidate yields a base, and message says why, including every candidate that was passed over. The first usable choice wins: the HARNESS_DEBT_RATCHET_BASE commit (or its merge-base with HEAD), then the merge-base of HEAD with the origin branch named by GITHUB_BASE_REF when set, origin/main and main, and finally HEAD^, which compares only the last commit.

examples.message: Ratchet base: merge-base of HEAD and origin/main.
origin/main does not exist. main does not exist. Ratchet base: HEAD^, so only the last commit is compared. Set HARNESS_DEBT_RATCHET_BASE to compare a wider range.
origin/main does not exist. main does not exist. HEAD has no parent: debt ratchets have no base. Set HARNESS_DEBT_RATCHET_BASE to compare a wider range.
